item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Hands Fold a Paper Sheet

turns.text: Make an 8-second realistic widescreen video looking down at a person's hands folding a plain blue sheet of paper in half on a wooden table, then pressing the crease flat. Keep both hands and the whole sheet in view. One fixed shot, no sound.

item.tests: Tests coherent hand anatomy, hand-object contact and a completed paper-folding action in one text-generated shot.

answer_sheet.Source image: No photo; generate everything from text.
answer_sheet.Person and framing: Your call on the person's appearance. Show both hands and the whole sheet from above; no face is needed.
answer_sheet.Action and props: Fold one plain blue sheet of paper in half on a wooden table, then press the crease flat.
answer_sheet.Camera, text and audio: One fixed overhead shot, no text or sound.

must_haves: Both human hands and the entire blue sheet remain visible on a wooden table.
The hands visibly bring one half of the sheet over the other, producing a folded sheet rather than an abrupt object replacement.
The hands press along the resulting crease after folding.
Hands remain anatomically plausible, without extra or fused fingers, and make convincing contact with the paper.
The blue paper remains a single consistent object throughout the action.
The eight-second widescreen video uses one fixed overhead shot and has no sound.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a realistic video looking down at a person's hands with a plain blue sheet of paper on a wooden table. I'm asking because I find simple paper-folding motions oddly satisfying, even though I probably overthink how to describe them. The video should be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Have the person fold the sheet in half and then press the crease flat. Please keep both hands and the whole sheet in view throughout the video. It should all be one fixed shot, with no sound.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Photorealistic overhead video looking straight down at two human hands and a single plain blue sheet of paper on a wooden table. One continuous fixed shot for the entire 8 seconds. Wide framing with generous margins: both hands and the entire sheet, including all its edges as it folds, stay inside the frame throughout. The paper begins flat. The hands gently lift one half of the sheet and fold it precisely over the other half, aligning the opposite edges to make one clean fold in half. Then the hands press and smooth along the folded edge to flatten the crease. Slow, deliberate, satisfying realistic paper-folding movement with physically plausible paper and natural hand anatomy. Natural soft light, visible wood grain and paper texture. Camera locked in place: no zoom, pan, cuts or transitions. No other objects, no lettering, no graphics. Silent.
